Subset of vradarserver/standing-data (CC0-1.0), recorded 2026-10-27: DLH400 (EDDF-KJFK), RYR6ZM (LEAL-EGBB, in the split file RYR-6) and the four airports.
Constructed (not real): DLH9MULTI (multi-leg), DLH8BROKEN (incomplete row), DLH7UNKNOWNAP (unknown airport), RYR1AB, and the quoted "New York, NY" location (exercises CSV quoting).
All files start with a UTF-8 BOM, as upstream. EWG9UX is absent upstream (and here).
